entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I'm not sure if I'm in the right place. I need to return something, but the website is just so overwhelming.
You've absolutely reached the right place, I can help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. Let me find the paper... okay, it's VF-8820-9153.
Great, thank you. Let me just pull that up... I'm showing an order for a pair of VeloFit `cycling shoes` that were delivered about 55 days ago. Is that the item?

Yes, that's them. I just couldn't get them to work for me. They gave me awful `blisters` on my heels, and I really struggled to install the `cleats` properly. I just want to send them back for a `refund`. Can't you just help me? I don't understand the process.
Of course. I'm sorry to hear the shoes weren't a good fit for you. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked our policy. All of our standard items, including these shoes, have a 90-day return window. Since it's only been 55 days, you are definitely eligible for a full refund. I can start that process for you right now.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all, you're well within the timeframe. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can simply print that out, place the shoes in the original box, and drop it off at your local shipping center. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item back at our warehouse.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. Thank you so much for your help, David.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
